channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.171.0
item.description: Codex CLI 0.171.0 arrives with a complete changelog spanning rust-v0.170.0 to rust-v0.171.0, alongside the latest ChatGPT and Codex updates, so you can trace what changed between the two releases. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: Improvements on the pull request overview in public preview
item.description: Since the November 5, 2026 public preview, the pull request Overview page now shows clearer merge status and next steps plus updated handling for failed optional checks, with a Try the Overview page button for switching to the classic view. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
item.description: Now in preview in the Gemini API, Tool Retrieval lets agents use hundreds of tools while cutting input tokens and latency by loading parameter schemas on demand via tool_search with defer_loading: true. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
item.description: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast (OpenAI News)

item.title: Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps generally available
item.description: Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps Services to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency are generally available, letting teams migrate repositories while continuing work and cut over on their own schedule. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
item.description: Walter Isaacson tells Google’s Kent Walker in Dialogues on Technology and Society that Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin and Ada Lovelace show breakthroughs are often team efforts and curiosity plus human judgment matter more as AI makes information abundant. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Anthropic CEO responds to $900 billion AI spending pledge: not exaggerated relative to current cash and revenue
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says a $900 billion AI investment commitment is not exaggerated when weighed against the company's cash reserves and annual revenue, and that he estimates future compute demand conservatively to avoid overstating it. (AIbase)

item.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux runner images now generally available
item.description: GitHub-hosted larger runners now offer generally available RHEL 9 and RHEL 10 images, moved from a June 2026 public preview with Red Hat to full production support in GitHub Actions for Team and Enterprise Cloud users. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Anthropic's record IPO raises $104.8 billion as seven co-founders cash out nearly $2 billion
item.description: Anthropic’s November 19 IPO raised $104.8 billion, far above Facebook’s 2012 $16 billion record, at an $83 offer price, with seven co-founders collectively cashing out $1.95 billion. (AIbase)

item.title: S3 audit log streaming with OpenID Connect expands to GHE.com
item.description: Enterprise audit logs on GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (GHE.com) can now stream to Amazon S3 via OpenID Connect, extending the github.com capability and removing the need to store long-lived AWS credentials on GitHub. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: ChatGPT voice input gets a major upgrade: real-time dictation goes live, the 10-minute limit is removed, and it's rolling out across platforms.
item.description: OpenAI has added real-time dictation to ChatGPT, showing editable transcriptions as users speak, removing the previous 10-minute limit, and rolling the feature out across web, desktop, iOS and Android. (AIbase)

item.title: Claude's in-house inference engine cuts first-token latency from 12 seconds to half a second
item.description: Claude's self-built inference engine cuts P90 first-token latency from roughly 12 seconds under SGLang to 0.48 seconds, with scheduling optimizations also lifting overall throughput and GPU output. (AIbase)

item.title: Google opens Genie4 world model API with real-time interaction and native audio generation
item.description: Google opened its Genie4 world model (models/genie-4) to paid developers on November 19 via the Gemini API and AI Studio, enabling 720p, 24fps interactive world generation with native audio. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO could deliver $156B to charity
item.description: At a $95 stock price, Anthropic’s Public Benefit Foundation, employee donations and the company’s match would together total $156 billion, and the article explains how that charitable pool is formed ahead of the lab’s IPO. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: Meta AI wearable Muse Charm reportedly priced at $300
item.description: Meta plans to price its electronic pet egg-style AI wearable Muse Charm at $300, setting it against the $250 Friend device and the broader contest over emotional companionship and character interaction in AI hardware. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
item.description: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share to raise more than $80 billion, then opened on Nasdaq at $111—33% above the IPO price—in the AI company’s first trading session. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: Gemini 4 Neon — Frontier reasoning with faster task completion
item.description: The "Gemini 4 Neon" page promises frontier reasoning and faster task completion, but its body serves only a CAPTCHA security check with no readable content, so access needs verifying first. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Losing 100 Billion and Still Ringing the Bell: The Compute Bill Behind Anthropic's Record-Breaking IPO
item.description: Anthropic raised about $81.3 billion in its November 19 Nasdaq listing as ANT, the largest IPO on record, yet its $900.9 billion in compute commitments include $70.7 billion due within a year, against a $1.26 billion operating loss. (AIbase)

item.title: Gemini 4 Neon tops the Models Engineering index
item.description: Gemini 4 Neon ranks first on the Models Engineering index, which standardizes benchmark scores, jointly fits model and benchmark effects, rescales to mean 50 and SD 10, and plots performance against cost and token use on log scales. (git-aarvin.github.io)

item.title: Room AI — Talk to it like a designer. Your room, one change at a time
item.description: Despite a headline promising that Room AI lets users "talk to it like a designer" and change a room one step at a time, the page serves only a CAPTCHA security check, with no product features, figures or usage details. (Product Hunt)
